name: Christmas Name Ornament
description: A flat Christmas ornament — bauble, star, tiered tree, heart or snowflake disc — with a name and an optional year line. Letters are raised or inlaid flush and shrink to fit the shape. Hangs from a loop above the top or a hole through the body. Three colours: body on extruder 1, text on extruder 2, and the border, bauble cap, tree star, loop and snowflakes on extruder 3.
source: inspired by Printables Customizable Christmas Name Ornament
